title: Coverage recovery Wave 03 part 5 — Talisman, Coin98, and Specter lifecycle depth
notes: Candidate IDs are provisional. Talisman has an exact first public release date. Coin98 V16 is recorded on the first-party monthly sync publication date because the source only establishes that launch occurred during June 2025, not an exact June day. Specter records a dated official prerelease as maintenance/lifecycle depth, not original launch.

events.title: Talisman Wallet Extension v1.0.0 publicly released
events.description: Talisman's official wallet release notes identify v1.0.0 on 2022-03-03 as the first public release of the wallet extension, documenting account creation/import, Polkadot and Kusama transaction signing, asset viewing and sending, dapp account authorization, address copying, and seed/JSON export.

events.title: Coin98 Super Wallet V16 launch documented
events.description: Coin98's June 2025 product sync states that Super Wallet V16 was officially launched during June, adding proactive wallet-risk and token-screening protections, trading improvements, and BOBA on-chain rewards. The publication does not establish an exact launch day in June, so this event is anchored to the dated first-party sync publication rather than inferring one.

events.title: Specter Desktop v2.2.0-pre5 released
events.description: The official Specter Desktop repository published the v2.2.0-pre5 prerelease on 2026-08-15 with packaged desktop artifacts, providing dated first-party evidence of continuing application maintenance. This record does not infer the product's original launch date.

evidence.title: Wallet Release Notes
evidence.notes: First-party Talisman release notes explicitly call v1.0.0 on 2022-03-03 the first public release of the wallet.

evidence.title: Coin98 Super Wallet | June Sync 2025
evidence.notes: First-party monthly sync states V16 was officially launched in June 2025 but does not provide an exact launch day.

evidence.title: Specter Desktop v2.2.0-pre5
evidence.notes: Official GitHub prerelease published 2026-08-15 with packaged desktop artifacts.
